next_guide.basis: The 2026-09-16 Q3 raise left the FY guide unchanged, so the implied Q4 fell to ~+16% (derived below) against H1 +32% and Q3 +21%. Amer has raised the FY guide at every 2026 print (May, August). Anta reported a September and Golden Week recovery in China. A raise is therefore the likely direction; its size against a street already at the top of the range is the open question.

findings.finding: Leaving the FY guide unchanged on 2026-09-16 while raising Q3 implies Q4 revenue growth of only about +16%, against +32% in H1 and +21% guided for Q3. The arithmetic: FY2025 revenue $6.566B x 1.24 = ~$8.14B; H1 2026 = H1 2025 ($1.474B Q1 + $1.236B Q2 = $2.71B) x 1.321 = ~$3.58B; Q3 at +21% on $1.756B = ~$2.125B; implied Q4 = ~$2.44B against Q4 2025 of ~$2.10B. A FY raise of at least the Q3 flow-through (+$20-40M, ~0.3-0.5pt) is close to mechanical, and the company raised the FY at the May and August prints. The street's FY EPS of $1.30 already sits at the top of the $1.27-1.30 guide, so a raise is expected; how far above the mechanical step it goes decides the reaction.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Beat-and-raise prints: 2025-11-18 +8.5% (30.76 to 33.36); 2026-05-19 +2.1%; 2026-08-18 +3.2% then -21% over the following month. A guide below the street on 2026-02-24 (initial FY2026 EPS) gave -5.6% (40.49 to 38.24). Yahoo 1y daily bars.
findings.why_not_priced: The sell side carries FY EPS at $1.30, the top of the guide, i.e. it prices the mechanical raise and not more. If the market priced a Q4 well above +16%, the FY consensus would sit above the guide range, and the stock would not be 9% lower in 5 sessions with sentiment called 'slightly bearish'.

findings.finding: The 2026-09-16/17 investor-day algorithm, on a FY2026 base, is group revenue CAGR low-double-digit to mid-teens, adj op margin +30-70+bp a year and a tax rate approaching 25%. Rough arithmetic on that frame (revenue +13-15%, margin +50bp from ~14.4%, tax from 28% toward 25%) gives 2027 EPS of about $1.55-1.62, against a street of $1.64. Any preliminary 2027 framing on the call would more likely trim the street than lift it; the February 2026 initial guide below the street cost -5.6%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-02-24: Q4 beat, initial FY2026 EPS guide below consensus on Salomon investment, -5.6% close to close.
findings.why_not_priced: The street's 2027 EPS of $1.64 (+26%) sits above what the company's own algorithm arithmetic yields. If the market had absorbed that, the 2027 number would be nearer $1.55-1.60. The formal 2027 guide comes in February (outside the window), so only call commentary can move it now.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly up, while the skew (+5.1, downside paid) and the -9% 5-day / -6.8pt-vs-sector 20-day run-up lean down. My case for the options being too bearish is that the slide came from On Holding with no Amer-specific news, and that the unchanged FY guide mechanically implies a raise. Because I go against the skew, p_up is held at 54.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction): beat-and-raise prints here bought only +2-3% in May and August, and the street already sits at the top of the FY guide. FY-raise finding cut from +1.5 to +1.0; reaction-history finding from +0.5 to +0.3.

Lesson 6 (a finding inside the guide is a reported-quarter item): the Q3 pre-raise lands inside what was guided, cut from +0.3 to +0.1. The bar is sourced to the company guide plus two agreeing estimate sources (MarketBeat, Earnings Whispers), so no cap.
Lesson 5 (proxies sized small): ONON peer -0.5 to -0.3, Moncler/TNF -0.3 to -0.2, Canada Goose +0.3 to +0.2, Anta counterparty +0.5 to +0.4.
Lesson 7 (a sign against the skew): I go against a +5.1 put-paid skew, so p_up moved from 55 to 54; short interest was checked (2.6 days to cover, not crowded).

Lesson 3 (caveats reach the number): the whisper finding was trimmed from -1.0 to -0.8 because the whisper has a single source; the price-path finding was trimmed from +1.0 to +0.8 because the skew reads the same slide as risk.
Minor trims: insider sale -0.2 to -0.1, analyst actions +0.2 to +0.1.
